summary: Full-stack testing of LMS RBAC Platform (5 portals). Backend: 38/38 pytest cases PASS covering auth for 4 roles, RBAC 403 enforcement, public endpoints, student CBT full grading flow (single/multiple/truefalse/essay with case-insensitive check), admin CRUD (news/calendar/course/broadcast/user/school/tryout+questions/slot assignment/partnership), tutor bidding + materials, proctor multi-tenant isolation (SMA Nusantara 1 only), analytics with class_trend, CSV download, and logout. Frontend: Login demo buttons + all 4 role redirects verified; RBAC redirect (student→/student when hitting /admin); student CBT engine loads 5 questions with timer for budi@lms.id; proctor UI correctly shows 'Memantau siswa dari SMA Nusantara 1' with 5 students, no Rizki/Maya leak; analytics renders 7 recharts SVGs; download-csv present; tutor bidding submits and status becomes 'Menunggu'; admin tryout builder opens and add-question-btn present; add-slot-btn / view-bids-* present on schedule; add-news/event/course/broadcast/user/school buttons all present; partnership items visible on admin/partnerships.
action_items: OPTIONAL/NAMING: Partnership form on landing uses data-testid prefix 'partner-*' (partner-org-name, partner-submit, etc.) while the review request spec used 'partnership-*'. Consider aligning prefixes to the spec for consistency, or update the spec. All fields functional.
OPTIONAL: Landing page has no 'nav-login' data-testid on its header login link (spec mentioned it). The /login route works; only the testid is missing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); FastAPI recommends lifespan context managers. Not blocking.
routes_admin.py update_partnership takes status via query-string not body — works but unconventional; consider a Pydantic body model.
Refresh cookie handling in routes_auth.py:148 duplicates set_auth_cookies logic (writes cookie inline). Reuse helper for consistency.
grading.py essay case-insensitive comparison confirmed working (test asserted). Good.
Proctor school isolation is enforced only by filtering user.school_id in queries — no defense-in-depth check on admin-created attempts. Acceptable for MVP.
test_credentials: Confirmed working: admin@lms.id/Admin@12345, tutor@lms.id/Tutor@12345, proktor@lms.id/Proktor@12345, siswa@lms.id/Siswa@12345, budi@lms.id/Siswa@12345 (fresh student used for CBT UI test since siswa was consumed by backend test).
seed_data_creation: No permanent seed added. Test-created data (news/calendar/course/broadcast/user/school/tryout) uses 'TEST_' prefix and is cleaned up in-test. One partnership 'TEST_Org' was left (public endpoint has no delete).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs green in ~7s (uses xdist). Note: the CBT flow test consumes siswa@lms.id's attempt for tryout to_3 — for UI live-take retests, use budi/siti/andi/dewi@lms.id (all Siswa@12345). Proctor isolation verified both API (test_only_school_students) and UI (monitoring page). Partnership testids use 'partner-*' prefix in code (not 'partnership-*' as in the review request).
rca of the issue: No issues found requiring RCA. All critical flows work end-to-end.
